select 'DEPOSIT_NONPHP_YTD',count(*),fulldate from eds.DEPOSIT_NONPHP_YTD group by fulldate

INSERT INTO
	 EDS.DEPOSIT_NONPHP_YTD

SELECT 
      TMP.FULLDATE
    , TMP.Previous_Business_Day
    , TMP.CUST_ID
    , TMP.GAM_ACID
    , TMP.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE
    , TMP.GAM_BANK_ID
    , TMP.GAM_SCHM_TYPE
    , CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP AS CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
    , CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP AS PREVIOUS_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
    , COALESCE((CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP ELSE CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP END),0) 
    + COALESCE(P_RUNNINGBAL.TOTAL_CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP,0) AS TOTAL_CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
    , TMP.DAYOFYEAR
    , (COALESCE((CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP ELSE CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP END),0) 
    + COALESCE(P_RUNNINGBAL.TOTAL_CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP,0)) / TMP.DAYOFYEAR AS YTD_BALANCE_PHP
FROM
    (
        SELECT FULLDATE
            , Previous_Business_Day
            , Business_Day_Flag
            , DAYOFYEAR
            , YEAR
            , CUST_ID
            , GAM_ACID
            , ACCT_CRNCY_CODE
            , GAM_BANK_ID
            , GAM_SCHM_TYPE
          FROM EDS.DATE_DIM
        JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT
            ON 1 = 1
            AND SUBSTRING(GAM_SCHM_CODE, 1, 2) <> '09'
			AND ACCT_CRNCY_CODE <> 'PHP'
        JOIN EDS.EDS_CTL
            ON DEPOSITS_DATE = AS_OF_DATE
        WHERE FULLDATE =CAST('2023-09-02' AS DATE)  
        AND GAM_ACID='PA376535' AND CUST_ID='A01331907'     
    ) TMP
LEFT JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT CURRENT_BD
    ON TMP.CUST_ID = CURRENT_BD.CUST_ID
        AND TMP.FULLDATE = CURRENT_BD.AS_OF_DATE
        AND TMP.GAM_ACID = CURRENT_BD.GAM_ACID
LEFT JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT CURRENT_PBD
    ON TMP.CUST_ID = CURRENT_PBD.CUST_ID
        AND TMP.Previous_Business_Day = CURRENT_PBD.AS_OF_DATE
        AND TMP.GAM_ACID = CURRENT_PBD.GAM_ACID
LEFT JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_NONPHP_YTD P_RUNNINGBAL
    ON TMP.CUST_ID = P_RUNNINGBAL.CUST_ID
        AND TMP.Previous_Business_Day = P_RUNNINGBAL.FULLDATE
        AND TMP.GAM_ACID = P_RUNNINGBAL.GAM_ACID;
